text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I let my guard down...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In such a pitiful state, 
I cannot face everyone in the club...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I cannot let things end like this...! At 
the very least, 
I must show everyone that I will not 
succumb to a mere injury...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We continue, Trainer. 
I will not halt these steps... never!
choice_data_list:
Then I won't let you push yourself, 
either.

text_block_list.text:
We continue, Trainer.

Then I won't let you push yourself,

Then I won't let you push yourself,

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... 
You would object?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me to pile further shame 
upon myself...?
choice_data_list:
If this makes it worse, that would be the 
real shame, wouldn't it?

If this makes it worse, that would be the 
real shame, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The resolve to hold back here is what is 
truly needed— 
is that what you believe?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We shall call an end to today's training. 
If only to ensure I present no pathetic 
display when the real day comes.
choice_data_list: Yeah, make sure to get plenty of rest.
Yeah, make sure to get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... what a stubborn disciple you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm, so be it. 
I shall demonstrate... my resolve.

And so, we decided to start 
with some light stretching, but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Kh, ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To think I misjudged this... 
How utterly pathetic...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How utterly immature I am... 
To think I could lead everyone like this 
is laughable.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
First, I must stand on my own two feet... 
All else must wait until then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Watch closely. 
—Witness that this flower shall never 
break.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Mm, no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is in no small part thanks to your 
adjustments to the regimen. You have my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I must learn from your example as well. 
—As one who leads.
